## API Reference: Family Tree Endpoints
- Persons
  - [Create Person](https://developers.familysearch.org/main/reference/createperson.md): Create a person.
  - [Read Person](https://developers.familysearch.org/main/reference/readperson.md): Retrieve a single Person by the personId.
